procedures.title: Warranty Validation Check
preconditions: Within first two years after purchase date
steps: Verify installation was done according to manual instructions
Verify product usage follows manual instructions
Ensure identification label on back of Touch 7 is intact and not removed

procedures.title: Identification Label Preservation
preconditions: Touch 7 device with identification label on back
steps: Locate identification label on back of Touch 7
Ensure label remains attached and undamaged
Do not attempt to remove or alter the label
procedures.expected_outcome: Maintained warranty validity and preserved service/maintenance information

procedures.title: Touch 7 Display Installation
preconditions: Mounting location with minimum 35mm depth clearance
steps: Select mounting location with adequate depth clearance (35mm minimum including cables)
Ensure front access is available for mounting
Connect power supply (8-32V DC)
Mount display from front of panel
Secure mounting without rear screws
procedures.expected_outcome: Touch 7 display securely mounted with power connection

procedures.title: Display Brightness Adjustment
steps: Access brightness controls through display interface
Adjust brightness level between 0-500 nits
Set appropriate level for current lighting conditions
Reduce brightness for night time viewing
procedures.expected_outcome: Display brightness optimized for viewing conditions

procedures.title: Network Connectivity Setup
preconditions: Wi-Fi network available or ethernet connection ready
steps: Access network settings on Touch 7
Select either Wi-Fi or ethernet connection method
Configure network parameters
Establish connection for tablet pairing
procedures.expected_outcome: Touch 7 connected to network for tablet connectivity
